namespace: Control string-mask selection or temporal input-mask toggle
type: string or string array for generic mask; boolean for temporal mask
default: no generic mask; temporal mask enabled unless false
effect: selects the generic masked string renderer and guides separators, or enables/disables a date/time input mask without changing temporal serialization rules
precedence: the generic renderer tester requires local options.mask on a string Control; schema.pattern or flat config.mask does not select it; boolean mask belongs only to the temporal renderer

effect: stores mask literals when true and only entered characters when false, while displaying the mask in either case
precedence: local value overrides the flat family config convention; absent uses flat config or false; schema validation applies to the stored representation

type: token map with regex strings or token objects
default: ASCII digit #, ASCII letter @, ASCII alphanumeric *
effect: customizes character acceptance; falsy entries remove tokens and invalid patterns produce a localized diagnostic
precedence: local token map overrides flat config; tokens takes precedence over legacy maskReplacers without merging the two

effect: determines whether removed token definitions stay removed or the masking engine restores its defaults
precedence: local value overrides flat config convention; absent uses flat config or true

effect: inserts mask literals eagerly when the masking engine reaches them
precedence: local value overrides flat config convention; absent uses flat config or false

effect: processes matching from the end of the mask
precedence: local value overrides flat config convention; absent uses flat config or false
